kim2017:scolopendra-subspinipes.note: dried traditional-medicine centipedes from three Korean regions; the paper reports % w/w AS IS: moisture/protein/fat/ash/fibre/carbohydrate SC 10.0/54.9/26.8/3.2/4.3/5.1, YG 8.0/55.7/28.4/3.2/4.2/4.7, JJ 4.5/55.8/30.6/3.3/4.4/5.8; the cells are the three-region mean put on dry matter by this task (as-is / (1 - moisture)), computed not read; carbohydrate by difference includes fibre; energy not reported (Atwater from the cells 540.5 kcal/100 g DM, computed); no fresh-animal moisture (the material was dried)

oonincx2012:porcellio-scaber.note: adults n = 1 pooled sample; dry matter 32.18 % read, so moisture 67.82 % (100 - DM, computed) and fresh = DM x 0.3218; fibre cell is NDF (ADF 5.04 % DM); ash 32.69 % DM is the mineralised exoskeleton (Ca 14.38 % DM); NFE and energy not reported; the text calls protein 41 %, fat 12 %, fibre <15 % DM
